in_marathi.name: Sankit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sankit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sankit is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sanket', which means 'auspicious', 'lucky', 'sign', 'message'. It signifies the presence of good fortune and blessings in one's life. In Hinduism, the word 'sanket' also refers to a symbolic sign or message that indicates the arrival of a deity or a significant event.
